status: Deviations and implementation notes of the TQE-viability pass (internal time-stamped record).

entries.state_when_written: P1 runs at 5 and 10 MHz complete; the first 15 MHz run had crashed before producing output; no P2 or P4 output existed.
entries.note: The first implementation of n_box assumed an integer IF period in ns and stopped at 15 MHz (period 66.7 ns). Fixed to the rule as written: the smallest boxcar of at least 200 samples spanning an integer number of IF periods (200 samples at 5, 10 and 15 MHz; P ceil(200/P) on the P2 grid). No existing output was affected.
